issue_context.title: Wrong message on the Groups Icon in the Scene View
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

The Icon next to the Node if it is in some sort of group says `Click to show signals dock` instead of `Click to show groups dock`

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f8f679d4-cc90-4882-81b6-eadd58190e52)


### System information

Linux Mint Cinnamon 21.3

### Issue description

The Icon next to the Node if it is in some sort of group says `Click to show signals dock` instead of `Click to show groups dock`

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f8f679d4-cc90-4882-81b6-eadd58190e52)

It could be a bit misleading cause clicking the icon takes to the group dock instead of the signals dock. It says otherwise.

### Steps to reproduce

Add a node to the scene tree.

Add a group to the node.

Hover on the group icon that appears

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

None
